text: Redmond Rovers build an attack from their own half on the left side, moving the ball through six passes over nearly 20 seconds, starting with a free kick close to the halfway line on the left flank. The ball travels steadily forward across the midfield and right channel, reaching Rory Mensah around 27 metres from Ironvale Athletic’s goal at the far end. Mensah receives a medium pass from Kian Coleman before shooting with his foot from distance and scoring, leveling the score at 1-1. The well-measured build-up exploits space left by Ironvale Athletic's deep defensive line. [#682] [#685] [#689] [#690]
